subject: ACME procurement: SOC 2 / DPA gating and purchase path (PO vs card, marketplace)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACME follow-up: procurement readiness + SOC 2 / DPA gating

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what it needs to kick off: 

1) Security/compliance gating
- You mentioned SOC 2 Type II evidence and a signed DPA are required before procurement can issue a PO. We can provide our 2025 Q4 SOC 2 report (attached) and a standard DPA (attached draft) for your legal.
- If your team wants answers to a security questionnaire, please send the spreadsheet and we'll have our security team respond within 48 hours.

2) Commercial path options
- PO (preferred by your finance): we are fine with PO + net 30. Procurement will need the SOW and a quote. I've attached a draft SOW and will generate a formal quote today.
- Card: supported for smaller pilots, but per our scale discussion PO is likely the right path.
- Marketplace: we can offer Redwood via our AWS Marketplace listing if you prefer procurement via marketplace procurement flows — let me know if that would accelerate purchase.

3) Next steps / asks (can we target next week?)
- Jordan / procurement: confirm whether PO or Marketplace is preferred and share any internal legal contacts for DPA review.
- Jordan: send the security questionnaire (if you have one) so we can triage dependencies.
- Marissa (me): I'll assemble the quote + HubSpot deal update and loop in our legal for DPA edits.

I'll follow up internally to confirm pricing cadence and any discounting approvals for the initial committed term.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: SOC2_Report_Redwood_v2025_Q4.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: DPA_draft_redwood.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: Redwood_SOW.docx (docx)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: ACME follow-up: procurement readiness + SOC 2 / DPA gating

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A few clarifications from procurement/legal side: 

- ACME prefers to transact via PO + net 30 for anything above $25k. For pilots <25k we can do card.
- We will need the SOC 2 report and the DPA provided to our legal counsel for review. If you can also provide a CSV/answers to the attached security questionnaire, that will speed approvals.
- Marketplace is attractive only if the pricing and term align (we avoid marketplace premiums). We can entertain it but it may require a separate internal approval.

I attached the questionnaire our security team uses. Can you confirm internal owner for questionnaire answers and an estimated timeline? Also please provide a formal quote and final SOW so procurement can scope the PO.

Jordan
Senior Procurement Manager | ACME, Inc.
jordan.lee@acme.com | +1 (212) 555-1234

Attachment: ACME_Security_Questionnaire_2026.csv (csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME follow-up: procurement readiness + SOC 2 / DPA gating

Jordan — got it, thanks. Quick commitments and owners from our side: 

- SOC 2 report: attached (SOC2_Report_Redwood_v2025_Q4.pdf).
- DPA: attached draft (DPA_draft_redwood.pdf). Our legal (Rachel Kim) will be primary for DPA edits; Rachel, I'll loop you in when ACME legal originates redlines.
- Security questionnaire: Neha (security) will take primary ownership. Neha, can you confirm turnaround?
- Formal quote & SOW: I'll send the quote today (expected within 2 business hours) and attach the final SOW.

We aim to have questionnaire answers back within 48 business hours after Neha confirms. If ACME can flag any high-priority items in the questionnaire, we'll prioritize those.

Regarding marketplace: we'll include marketplace vs PO pricing lines on the quote so procurement can compare total cost.

Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ACME follow-up: SOC 2 / questionnaire ownership

Marissa / team —

I've reviewed the ACME questionnaire. Estimated timeline: full completed spreadsheet within 48 hours (EOD Mon 8 Mar) assuming no deep-dive requests. High-level notes: 
- We can answer the majority of items directly; where evidence is requested we'll attach relevant artifacts or reference the SOC 2 report.
- There are two items that typically require legal discussion (data residency and subprocessor list). Rachel, please be prepared to respond if ACME flags those.

I'll start populating tonight and will coordinate with infra for a quick artifact pull.

-Neha
Head of Information Security | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: ACME follow-up: procurement readiness + SOC 2 / DPA gating

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the plan — this should get procurement moving. A few confirmations from our side: 

- ACME will proceed with PO + net 30 once legal signs off on the DPA and we receive the SOC 2 evidence + questionnaire responses.
- Please route the final quote with marketplace vs PO lines to procurement@acme.com and cc my team.
- Our legal (Priya Shah) will originate any DPA redlines — Rachel, expect an email from Priya within 48 hours.

If we can get questionnaire responses and the final quote by end of day Monday, procurement will prioritize PO creation next week.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this pilot.

Jordan
